thread:
Alex: Quick proposal — implement deterministic sampling + short eval snapshots for staged rollouts. goal: reduce noisy signals and make regressions reproducible.
Maria: agree. can you outline the sampling/gating approach?
Alex: plan: deterministic shard by salted tenant hash, tiny initial slice, periodic anonymized snapshots. basic config below.
Samir: privacy-first: strip identifiers, truncate long contexts, store prompt-hash and output-hash only (no raw PII).
Alex: exact snapshot fields: seed, model_version, prompt_hash, output_hash, anonymized_meta, metrics. retention TTL default 90d.
Jess: gating metrics suggestion: latency_p95, error_rate, human_quality_score, cost_per_request. include slope over last 30m.
Maria: rollout windows: preflight canary 0.05% for 45m, then increments 0.1 -> 1 -> 5 -> 20 -> 100 per region, observe 30-60m each step.
Alex: sample config (ops-friendly):
```
flag: staged_v2_rollout
sample_rate: 0.001  # 0.1%
seed: salted_tenant_hash
buckets: [control, candidate]
snapshot_interval: 5m
snapshot_sample: 200
gates:
  - latency_p95 < 300ms for 15m
  - error_rate < 1% for 15m
  - quality_drop > -0.03
rollback_if:
  - sustained_gate_breach > 10m
  - human_complaint_rate x3 baseline
```
Samir: deterministic seed must be env-salted and allow manual pin for specific customers. also add a privacy sanitization hook before snapshotting.
Jess: storage: short-term internal store + optional customer S3 export with KMS. default TTL 90 days, enterprise export 365d. ops to manage export jobs and ACLs.
Maria: evaluation loop: every 5m snapshot for 1h after each increment, run automated evals and surface any flagged regressions to human raters. human queue owners rotate during canary windows.
Alex: ownership: product owns snapshot schema & eval thresholds, eng owns seeding + sanitization, ops owns retention/export + alerting.
Maria: launch checklist bullets:
- preflight checks: smoke run in a canary region (0.05%) pass gates
- staged ramps with observation windows
- no untriaged SLO breaches
- cost delta within expected band
- human review cleared for regressions
Samir: add immediate hard-stop: any verified customer data exposure or privacy incident -> freeze + rollback.
Jess: ops-bot will create an incident channel and page on-call raters during ramps.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary started us-east-1 at 2024-06-20T09:10Z slice=0.05%
Alex: timeline ask: prototype in 10 business days, internal canary the following week. blockers?
Samir: need small runtime change to expose salted tenant hash before truncation; i'll open PR today.
Maria: i'll author the one-pager with gating thresholds and example queries for the eval harness.
Jess: i'll provision S3 export path + KMS policy and wire ops-bot alerts.
Alex: great. i'll post the one-pager and minimal flag YAML later today. :thumbsup:
summary: Deterministic tenant-sharded sampling + anonymized eval snapshots for staged rollouts. proposed gates, rollout windows, storage/retention, ownership, and timeline.
